title: Where Culture Fades: Revealing the Cultural Gap in Text-to-Image Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating cross-lingual cultural consistency in text-to-image models by generating images from noun-only prompts translated into 15 different languages, and assessing whether the outputs reflect the target language's specific socio-cultural context or default to English-centric/neutral prototypes. This is measured using a VQA classification metric (CultureVQA) and human evaluation metrics including Multi-Choice Culture (MCC), Single-Choice Culture (SCC), and Cultural Semantic Relevance (CSR).

Comparing the visual outputs of text-to-image models when prompted with equivalent terms across different languages to reveal English-centric or culturally neutral defaults under low-resource or non-English multilingual prompts.
